name: Randomize tiling
description: Breaks up repetitive tiling images with a random offset and orientation for tiles and blending the edges.

parameters.name: Tile width
parameters.desc: Width of each tile in pixels.

parameters.name: Tile height
parameters.desc: Height of each tile in pixels.

parameters.name: Blend margin X
parameters.desc: Percentage of tile width that fades to adjacent tile.

parameters.name: Blend margin Y
parameters.desc: Percentage of tile height that fades to adjacent tile.
